verdicts.evidence: The sentinel replaces [] only when `runs` is not an array; iterating it yields a string element whose `?.tool` is undefined, so no rule and no result is seen and the verdict stays "absent". Byte-identical over 645 calls on 43 documents, including runs:null, runs as an object, and an object-shaped runs carrying error-level findings.

verdicts.evidence: The sentinel replaces [] only when `driver.rules` is not an array; the string element has no `.id`, so `rules.find` never matches and `rules[res.rule.index]?.id` stays undefined. verdicts.evidence: 645 sarifRuleResult calls over 43 SARIF documents (null and primitive result entries included) were byte-identical. The line is reached only after `if (id !== ruleId) continue`, and for a string ruleId a null or primitive `res` yields id === undefined, so `res` is always an object there; both callers (evidence.ts, spec-conformance.ts) pass a string behind a `p.symbol !== undefined` guard.
